titulo_es: Adapt a message to the recipient

Skriv det mer formellt.en: Can you write it more formally?

texto: Assess a publication and adapt a message to the addressee and the media. **Skriv det mer formellt** means «Can you write it more formally?». It relates the expression to the purpose of the text. Look at the connectors and reformulate the idea with your own words before you respond. Sequence 2 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
